errors.text: The proposed alloy, substrate, and macroscopic sliding experiment do not reconstruct the FeNiCrCoCu/Cu nanoindentation-friction simulation.
The dominant oxide-scale mechanism is incompatible with the target's nonreactive molecular-dynamics model, in which oxidation cannot occur.
The proposed 600–800 K degradation boundary misses the target's approximately 900 K onset of rapid lattice disorder and mechanical softening.
